user.title: Huali dormitory meter
user.description:
Pick your campus and enter the dormitory room code (for example {example}).

The room code can be found in the [Huali meter site]({url}) (WeChat: 用户管理 → 选择楼栋).
The integration binds the room with its own identifier; your WeChat binding is not affected.

error.invalid_room: Room not found, please double-check the building and room code (for example A1-105).
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach dbwx.hlsywy.com, please try again later.
error.bind_failed: Unable to bind the room, please try again later.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, check the Home Assistant log.

init.title: Huali meter options
init.description: Adjust the polling interval. Every 30 minutes is plenty; shorter intervals may be rate limited.
